title: RBAC privacy and incident tabletop rehearsal across backend/ and docs/

implementation_summary.goal: Multi-tenant RBAC privacy and security incident tabletop rehearsal across school and marketplace partner domains, verifying consent revocation and zero sensitive cross-account or cross-tenant leakage under adversarial conditions.

rehearsal_scenarios.description: Adversarial Teacher B and rogue Student B from School B attempt unauthorized access, data harvesting, and cross-submission into School A.
rehearsal_scenarios.defense_verified: Strict 403 Forbidden with empty details on School management, Class Roster, Gradebook, and Assignment Submission; unverified teachers blocked with UNVERIFIED_TEACHER_ACCESS_DENIED.

rehearsal_scenarios.description: Adversarial craft partner (Partner B) attempts to view or hijack inquiries belonging to Partner A via API and ?provider query param poisoning.
rehearsal_scenarios.defense_verified: Non-admin calls scoped strictly to own inquiries; ?provider parameter ignored; cross-tenant PATCH rejected with 403 FORBIDDEN_SCOPE; non-existent UUID returns 404 NOT_FOUND.

rehearsal_scenarios.scenario: School pilot guardian consent revocation drill
rehearsal_scenarios.description: Legal guardian invokes right-of-withdrawal under Decree 13/2023/ND-CP Article 11 for a minor student under an ethics protocol.
rehearsal_scenarios.defense_verified: Consent status transitions to withdrawn; subsequent empirical assessment submissions fail with 403 GUARDIAN_CONSENT_WITHDRAWN; student data automatically excluded from research metrics.

rehearsal_scenarios.scenario: Marketplace inquiry consent withdrawal and PII scrubbing
rehearsal_scenarios.description: Visitor invokes right to erasure using high-entropy bearer token.
rehearsal_scenarios.defense_verified: Opaque token lookup enforces zero-PII; withdrawal scrubs name to '[ANONYMIZED]' and contact to '[REDACTED]'; state becomes 'closed'; partner inquiry list shows redacted details with zero leak.

rehearsal_scenarios.scenario: Security incident containment & kill switch rehearsal
rehearsal_scenarios.description: SEV-1 incident activation tripping emergency kill switches for AI Tutor and RBPC Commerce.
rehearsal_scenarios.defense_verified: Admin-only kill switch management; immediate runtime override disabling affected subservices; Golden Rule 1 preserved: public heritage catalog (Heritage Places, Stories) remains 100% online; recovery restores normal operations.

negative_abuse_invariants.zero_cross_tenant_leakage: PASSED - Zero sensitive foreign student names, emails, guardian contacts, or scores leaked to adversarial actors.
negative_abuse_invariants.zero_cross_partner_leakage: PASSED - Zero customer booking contact details, notes, or inquiry IDs leaked to foreign craft partners.
negative_abuse_invariants.decree_13_erasure_enforcement: PASSED - Immediate synchronous redaction of visitor PII and complete revocation of minor student consent in research evaluations.
